description: Biz bilimi, uzayı ve teknolojiyi seven, meraklı ve yaratıcı dört kızdan oluşan bir takımız. Yeni fikirler keşfetmeyi, problemleri çözmeyi ve birlikte öğrenmeyi seviyoruz. Amacımız hayal gücümüzü yenilikçi çözümlere dönüştürmek ve bir fark yaratmak!
summary:
Lonely Moon is an illustrated children’s storybook about three real space explorers: Lunokhod 1, Luna 9, and Yutu 1. In our fictional story, they meet on the Moon and share their experiences, including when they arrived, what their missions were, and how long they worked.

Our project addresses the storytelling challenge by turning facts about space exploration into a story that children can enjoy and understand. We combine historical mission details with imagination, dialogue, and illustrations to introduce young readers to these explorers.

The story also explores loneliness, courage, and friendship. Although the three explorers come from different times and places, they find a connection through their shared experiences. This project is important because it encourages curiosity about space and shows how storytelling can make science more engaging and memorable.
details:
Lonely Moon is an illustrated children’s storybook that combines real space exploration history with an imagined meeting on the Moon. It follows Lunokhod 1 as he meets Luna 9 and Yutu 1. Through their conversations, readers learn about the explorers’ arrival dates, missions, and achievements.

The book has six story sections, each presented on a text page followed by a matching illustration. We used large golden lettering, dark space backgrounds, and consistent character designs to make the book readable and visually connected. A front cover and a short back-cover description complete the book.

Our goal is to help children become curious about space exploration through an enjoyable story. Instead of presenting mission details as a list, we let the explorers tell their own stories. The themes of courage, loneliness, and friendship also give young readers an emotional connection to the characters.

We used Gemini to gather information about the space explorers and their missions. We used ChatGPT to help with page planning and cover text. AI image-generation tools helped us create and revise the illustrations. No coding languages or special hardware were needed.

The creative element is bringing three real explorers from different periods together as characters. During development, we considered readability, visual consistency, the balance between facts and fiction, and preserving the young author’s original voice and ideas.
